svg.aria-label: Three ways to run Dueproof. Hosted, run by us at dueproof-app.vercel.app on Vercel, Neon and Cloudflare R2, with plans with or without AI; data is stored in Singapore and Asia-Pacific. Self-hosted, free on your own server with Docker Compose: four containers behind Caddy, no telemetry, nightly backups; the Business edition adds SAML single sign-on from ee/. Desktop, a Tauri 2 app that connects to a server, with OS notifications, a tray, deep links and start at login; it runs on Linux today, and Windows and macOS builds are coming. On a phone, the web app installs as a PWA with camera capture and Web Push.
